personalInfo.statement: Hi, my name is Hanniel Holness. I’m 21 years old, and a senior at UNCC, majoring in computer science. I’m a transfer student, having earned an Associate’s Degree before coming to Charlotte. I specialize in cybersecurity, so I’m aiming for an industry job that focuses on that after graduation.
personalInfo.personalBackground: I moved to NC from the UK 4 years ago.
personalInfo.professionalBackground: I took an internship while at community college. I’m also working two jobs, including as an Instructional Assistant.
personalInfo.academicBackground: I have an Associates in Science degree. I’m also an early entry student for the Masters in Cybersecurity program (i.e., taking graduate and undergraduate courses at the same time).
